description_en: Query the downloadable call recording URL by call ID on the enterprise side
description_zh: 企业侧通过callId查询可下载的通话录音地址
kebab_example: aliyun dyplsapi query-sound-record --req-id 5640000000000879 --caller-parent-id 1 --customer-pool-key FC50000000000000000000000a1a --call-id ac445343254 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QuerySoundRecord

parameters.help_en: The request deduplication ID. The maximum length is 20 characters. Ensure the atomicity of the request ID
parameters.help_zh: 请求去重ID，最大长度为20位，请确保请求ID的原子性
parameters.name: req_id

parameters.help_en: The customer UID. This parameter is automatically obtained by the system and does not need to be specified
parameters.help_zh: 客户UID，系统自动获取，无需输入
parameters.name: caller_parent_id

parameters.help_en: The call ID that uniquely identifies a call
parameters.help_zh: 通话ID，唯一确定的一次通话
parameters.name: call_id
